simple.summary: תַּעֲנוּג (taʻănûwg) means luxury First listed occurrence: Eccl 2 8.

definitions.full: H8588. taanug תַּעֲנוּג noun [masculine] daintiness, luxury, exquisite delight ; — 1 luxury: ׳ת Prov 19:10 ; elsewhere plural; construct תַּעֲנֻגוֺת Eccl 2:8 . 2 suffix תַּעֲנוּנָ֑יִךְ בְּנֵי Micah 1:16 thy dainty sons ; תַּעֲנֻגֶיהָ בֵּית 2:9 her (their) dainty house(s) , > of tender love (reading בְּנֵי 2:9 We Now. 3 delight of love, plural absolute בַּתַּעֲנוּגִים Cant 7:7 (Perles Anal. 22 f. conjecture עַמִּינָדָב בַּת ).
